title: Priority claim: matchings of the n-prism with one spoke or one rim edge deleted equal recurrence-defined sequences - Lean 4 formalized proof + claim note (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Claim of record (priority deposit): a claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the frozen Lean 4 statement snapshot, the complete machine proof (mathlib v4.34.0, 0 sorry, #print axioms within the standard whitelist), the final adjudication record, the listing byte-exactness check, and the full C9 novelty-search record including every zero-hit query. Results: for every n >= 3, the number of matchings of the n-prism graph C_n x P_2 with one spoke (rung) edge deleted equals the frozen sequence aspoke(n-3) (initial values 25, 86, 271, 876), and with one rim (perimeter) edge deleted equals arim(n-3) (initial values 26, 86, 274, 883); both sequences satisfy the fourth-order recurrence a(n+4) = 2a(n+3) + 4a(n+2) - a(n) of the prism graph's own matching sequence A102080 (same signature, different initial values), counted in the Hosoya sense with the empty matching included. Both theorems compile with no sorry; #print axioms over all 11 audited declarations is a subset of [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's C9 exclusivity review and included here in full with every zero-hit query (screening dossier 41 queries + graph-side increment 31 queries over six channels, five positive controls all passing; OEIS signature (2,4,0,-1) index page holds exactly 4 registered sequences and neither slice is among them): no occupying record found (reachable-channel scope). Value tier: new sequence (both slices unregistered; the recurrence itself is the mother A102080's registered formula and no new-recurrence claim is made); the graph-side bridge is graded first formalisation (Lean three-layer zero same-form), never new mathematics. Recorded exposures: the Aldred-Plummer 2017 matching-extension record is structural (n-extendability), its full text is paywalled and unread; the ladder-side Farrell 1983 record concerns ladders, not prisms; a zero hit is not novelty. The note is licensed CC BY 4.0 and the code MIT. Produced by the AI4Math pipeline (LLM generation + Lean kernel adjudication; task budgets copied verbatim from the task ledger: agent-run samples 12 of 20, formal kernel compiles 17 of 36, llm-calls 4 of 8 plus 4 transmission failures, compile-debug probes 23; this note consumed 0 pipeline LLM calls against a cap of 4).
